claims.text: Benzoyl peroxide washes for the axillae, inframammary areas, groin, external genitalia and buttocks; rinse well to avoid bleaching clothing
claims.quote: Skin affected by hidradenitis suppurativa can be washed with benzoyl peroxide washes; this includes the axillae, inframammary, groin, external genitalia, and the buttocks. Skin should be rinsed well to avoid peroxide-induced bleaching of the clothing.
